picks.why: Same rocket as 1, but bigger and better centred, so it fills the frame the way the real submarine does.

Larger and fills the frame. 1 is the same meteor, smaller and pushed off-centre.

A larger three-quarter view that fills the card like the real popcorn cart. 1 sits small, high and to the right, over too much floor.
The largest of three near-identical rovers. It's in three-quarter view and fills the frame like the real taxi.
